# Android Instrumentation & Performance Test Analysis

Date: 2025-11-05
Scope: Data-layer (Room/Repository) + Integration (Sync/ContextTemplate/CrossPlatform) + Performance
CI: GitHub Actions (macOS HVF emulator via reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner)

---

1) Root causes of failures/exceptions

- MockWebServer lifecycle coupling (EventRepositoryTest)
  - Symptom: Subsequent tests fail intermittently after a test shuts down the server.
  - Cause: One test calls MockWebServer.shutdown(); following tests reuse stale server instance.
  - Fix: Create a fresh MockWebServer in @Before for each test; always shutdown in @After with try/catch.

- Weak assertions in integration test (OfflineFirstTest)
  - Symptom: Test always passes regardless of real state (assertTrue(true)).
  - Cause: Placeholder assertion instead of verifying sync queue state.
  - Fix: Replace with real checks (getPendingCount(), getPendingOperations()).

- Non-null assertion misuse (CrossPlatformSyncTest)
  - Symptom: Potential NPE or redundant !! usage in assertions.
  - Cause: Using createdAt!! directly inside assertTrue.
  - Fix: assertNotNull first, then assert on the value without !!.

- Coroutine test context inconsistency (previously in performance tests)
  - Symptom: “suspend function called from non-coroutine” during Room transaction.
  - Cause: Suspend DAO calls inside runInTransaction without coroutine context.
  - Fix: Wrap DAO inserts with runBlocking inside runInTransaction OR avoid mixing suspend in non-suspend lambdas; use runTest in test methods.

---

2) Code-level fixes or test adjustments (applied)

- EventRepositoryTest.kt
  - New MockWebServer per test; robust @After shutdown.
  - Offline test uses repository with null API instead of shutting server down.

- OfflineFirstTest.kt
  - Replaced assertTrue(true) with checks on sync queue accessibility and counts.
  - Added pre/post restart validations; clarified in-memory DB expectations.

- CrossPlatformSyncTest.kt
  - Removed unnecessary !! in date format validation; added descriptive assertion message.

- Performance tests (earlier change)
  - Switched to runTest; added warm-up; fixed suspend calls within transactions; added warmUpDatabase helper.

---

3) Performance warnings: optimizations and caching improvements

- Room DB
  - Keep PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL for better write concurrency (consider enabling for in-memory if supported by instrumentation setup).
  - Batch writes within runInTransaction (already done). If large bulk ops, consider insert(List<>) DAO to reduce per-call overhead.
  - Ensure essential indices exist for filters (status, created_at) — currently validated by performance tests.
  - Optionally enable prepared statements via Room KTX (default behavior is adequate).

- UI/Espresso/Compose
  - Use IdlingPolicies (already applied) and prefer IdlingResources over Thread.sleep where feasible.
  - Consider ActivityScenarioRule to simplify lifecycle management.
  - Avoid heavy work on main thread in test-only screens; rely on repository fakes or seeded DB when possible.

- Network/Repository
  - Cache hot paths in Repository layer (e.g., last page of events) if tests repeatedly access same queries.
  - For flows used in UI benchmarks, seed DB and subscribe once per test run to reduce cold-start overhead.

- Emulator/CI stability
  - Emulator options are reasonable: -no-window, swiftshader_indirect, no snapshot. Consider adding: -noaudio -camera-back none -camera-front none.
  - If boot times fluctuate, increase emulator-boot-timeout slightly or add an adb wait-for-device step.

---

4) Structured PR suggestions

Title: test(android): harden integration tests and optimize performance setup

Summary:
- Stabilize MockWebServer lifecycle per test case.
- Replace weak assertions with verifiable conditions.
- Remove unsafe non-null assertions in tests.
- Standardize coroutine testing with runTest; keep runBlocking only inside transactions when required.
- Add DB warm-up and batching guidance to performance tests.

Changes:
- test(android): EventRepositoryTest — instantiate/shutdown MockWebServer per test; offline path uses null API.
- test(android): OfflineFirstTest — replace assertTrue(true) with sync queue checks; clarify in-memory semantics.
- test(android): CrossPlatformSyncTest — safer date assertions.
- test(android): Performance tests — runTest, warm-ups, and safe suspend usage (already merged).

Follow-ups (optional):
- Add a small TestUtils.kt with reusable warmUpDatabase() and measure helpers shared across tests.
- Introduce ActivityScenarioRule for UI tests and favored IdlingResources over sleeps.
- Consider enabling WAL mode explicitly during instrumentation to mirror production characteristics.
- Extend workflow emulator-options with -noaudio -camera-back none -camera-front none and add adb wait-for-device.

Verification:
- ./gradlew :app:compileLocalDebugAndroidTestKotlin — SUCCESS
- Local emulator run: connectedLocalDebugAndroidTest executes without infrastructure errors.
- Artifacts present under android-test-artifacts with logs and reports.
